text:
maria: Heads-up: Targeting tonight's pilot window 23:00-01:00 UTC for the `contact_phone_normalize` migration + progressive backfill. Planning a small pilot then ramp if healthy.

deploybot: [deploybot] migration scheduled: id=2026-07-02-phone-norm, window=pilot-23-01. Prechecks running. To approve: `/deploy approve 2026-07-02-phone-norm`

simon: TL;DR on changes: add `phone_normalized` varchar(32) NULL, populate via idempotent backfill. Backfill uses shard-aware workers, initial throttle 300 rows/s.

lee: Compatibility note: api-gateway v3.2.0 must be deployed during the window (contains relaxed JSON validation). I'll patch the k8s rollout to v3.2.0 before starting pilot.

maria: Pilot plan: 10% tenant set for 8 minutes. If stable, move to 40% for 12 minutes then full. Ops watch for locks, replica lag, and consumer errors.

opsbot: Health metrics to watch: api_5xx_rate, db_replica_lag_seconds, db_lock_wait_p95. Alerts created: phone-mig-5xx (>0.5% sustained 5m), phone-mig-lag (>45s sustained 8m), phone-mig-lock (>1s p95 sustained 3m).

simon: Rollback procedure prepped: stop workers, run `pg_cancel_backend` for long queries, then run migration rollback stored proc:
```
CALL migrations.rollback('2026-07-02-phone-norm');
```
Expect 90-180s to remove column if needed; backfill will stop earlier.

deploybot: Preflight complete: indexes verified, deps ok. Holdpoint: waiting for `/deploy continue --pilot=10%`

maria: Approving. `/deploy continue 2026-07-02-phone-norm --pilot=10%`

deploybot: Pilot started @1781234620. Targeting tenant cohort alpha-10. Health snapshots every 60s.

simon: Pilot progress: 4.8k rows processed, avg row time 18ms. No lock escalations observed.

lee: k8s patch applied: api-gateway -> v3.2.0 (rolled 2/3 pods so far). Leave one old pod for compatibility check.

infra: Observability: replica lag spiked to 38s on shard-7 at t+5m, recovered to 12s within 90s. Noting shard-7 as "sensitive" for full rollout.

opsbot: Alert check: no phone-mig alerts fired. api_5xx_rate at 0.12% (below threshold).

maria: Pilot green. Proceed to 40% after 10m stable.

deploybot: Advancing pilot to 40% at ts=1781234720. Throttle auto-adjust to 500 rows/s with shard-adaptive smoothing.

simon: Backfill at 40%: p95 lock_wait increased to ~850ms on shard-3 intermittently. We cut per-shard rate to 200 rows/s for shard-3.

lee: Reminder to pin writer-service to v1.9.4 via feature-flag for 30m post-migration; I'll push the flag now.

infra: Replica lag note: shard-11 creeping to 50s after ramp on one replica. Recommend pausing full rollout until we investigate.

maria: Pause full rollout. Rolling back ramp to 40% hold. We'll investigate shard-11 and lower rates further.

simon: Investigation: long-running UPDATEs on shard-11 due to large tenant X hot-rows. Plan: exclude tenant X from full rollout, lower global throttle to 350 rows/s, re-run canary expansion.

opsbot: Change recorded: excluded tenant X (id=9999) from rollout. New throttle=350 rows/s.

maria: OK restart expansion to 60% excluding tenant X. `/deploy continue 2026-07-02-phone-norm --pilot=60% --exclude=9999`

deploybot: Moving to 60% at ts=1781234820. Health checks every 60s.

simon: Progress: overall p95 lock_wait now 430ms; shard-11 stable at 18s replica lag.

infra: Post-change watch window: 30m starting now. If any of the following occur trigger rollback: api_5xx_rate >1% sustained 3m, replication lag >90s, persistent locks >3s p95 across >=2 shards.

lee: Release notes draft: "Adds phone_normalized column and progressive backfill. No expected consumer changes; small tail-latency increase possible for ~30-45m. Excluded tenant(s): 9999." I'll publish after final status.

maria: Full rollout approved if next 20m stable. For record: postmortem if any rollback. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
